# EverPlus Home Appliance Repair Services

> EverPlus provides verified same-day doorstep home appliance repair, installation, and maintenance services in Raipur, Chhattisgarh.

EverPlus is an independent local service company specializing in emergency repairs and periodic maintenance for household electrical cooling and cleaning appliances across all major brands (Voltas, LG, Samsung, Whirlpool, Godrej, IFB, Blue Star, Daikin, Haier, Panasonic, Sony, TCL, Lloyd, etc.).

## Core Services
- [AC Repair & Servicing](https://everplushomeservice.in/): Split and window AC cooling issues, gas charging/refilling, PCB repair, deep jet pump servicing, compressor replacement.
- [Refrigerator Repair](https://everplushomeservice.in/): Single door, double door, and side-by-side fridge cooling failure, thermostat replacement, compressor repair, defrosting issues.
- [Washing Machine Repair](https://everplushomeservice.in/): Front-load, top-load, semi-automatic drum vibration, drainage block, PCB/motor fix, error code diagnosis.
- [Microwave Oven Repair](https://everplushomeservice.in/): Solo, grill, and convection microwave sparking, heating failure, magnetron replacement, turntable motor repair.
- [LED & Smart TV Repair](https://everplushomeservice.in/): Panel lines, backlight replacement, power supply repair, sound issues for 32" to 75" TVs.

## Service Coverage Areas (Raipur)
- Pandri, Shankar Nagar, Devendra Nagar, Telibandha, Byron Bazar, Civil Lines, Purani Basti, Tatibandh, Gudhiyari, Samta Colony, Naya Raipur (Atal Nagar), and surrounding neighborhoods.
